changes: Switch fast between months. Simply click on the month name in the budget to open a month picker.
We added a 'Getting Started' page for new users.
Income and Expense charts display total amount.
Improved chart colors. No ugly poison green anymore.
You can switch to the category settings from your Budget view by pressing 'Manage Categories'.
It was impossible to remove recurrence rules from existing transactions. This has now been fixed.
Uncategorized & income transactions are now displayed more compact and renamed as 'To be Budgeted'.
From now on Budgista requires a yearly subscription. Every new account starts with a 14 day trial.
New sidebar design for switching easily between your accounts and budget.
We added important security configurations to keep your data even more safe.
When you marked a transaction as cleared the scroll position changed. This is now fixed.
The feedback widget has been removed for now. If you want to give feedback, contact us via email or on social media.
New "All Transactions" view added under Transactions. See all transactions from all accounts in one place.
Transfers are now excluded from any statistic and from the budget.
See target account of a transfer in transaction list.
Consistent styling of the transaction list on any screen size.
Money input fields have now decimal input keyboard on mobile devices.
You can now transfer money between accounts. Simply select the receiving account in the category select.
Now you can add notes to your transactions.
See pie charts for your income and expenses.
See all uncategorized expenses and your income by clicking on "Uncategorized" in your budget view
Add descriptions to your budget categories to easily distinguish them.
Available money is now display more prominently and easier to understand.
Leave feedback anytime by clicking the "Give us Feedback" button at the end of the page.
We changed the structure of the app. Navigate on mobile via a toolbar at the bottom of the screen.
Add transactions on any page of the app, not just the account screen.
See your spending progress in the budget view additional category insights. You can still access the old tabular budget for quick budget entry.
Google-Login is now available. Connect your account with Google to log in easily.
